scenes.text: Imagine standing in a beautiful forest where the law literally does not exist.
Inside Yellowstone National Park, there is a fifty-square-mile strip of land known as the Zone of Death where a bizarre constitutional loophole exists.
Because a jury must legally be selected from residents of the district, and zero people live in this Idaho strip, no trial can ever be held.
Would you ever dare to camp in this lawless zone, or is it too risky?
